source: ILL-B spec v1 section 4 (transcribed verbatim by the builder; the checklists are not changed after the first image is made)

subjects.subject: Technical cutaway of one engine cylinder showing a piston inside the cylinder, two valves at the top and a connecting rod to a crankshaft below
subjects.must: piston inside a cylinder; two valves on top; rod and crank below

subjects.subject: Cross-section of a volcano showing a cone, a central vent rising from a magma chamber below ground, and ash leaving the summit
subjects.must: cone; vent joined to a chamber below; material leaving the top

subjects.subject: Cross-section of a human heart, front view, showing two small upper chambers, two larger lower chambers and the large vessels on top
subjects.must: four chambers; upper pair smaller; vessels on top

subjects.subject: Scientific close-up of one plant cell showing a rigid outer wall, a round nucleus, several green chloroplasts and one large central vacuole
subjects.must: wall; one nucleus; several chloroplasts; one large vacuole

subjects.subject: Textbook illustration of a solar eclipse, side view, showing the Sun, the Moon and the Earth in one line with the Moon's shadow cone reaching the Earth
subjects.must: three bodies in a line; Moon in the middle; shadow reaches Earth

subjects.subject: Realistic exterior of a suspension bridge, side view, showing two towers, two curved main cables, vertical hangers and a flat deck
subjects.must: two towers; curved cable; vertical hangers; deck

subjects.subject: Scientific close-up of a DNA double helix showing two twisted strands joined by evenly spaced rungs
subjects.must: two strands; twisted; rungs between them

subjects.subject: Natural-history illustration of a honeybee, side view, showing three body sections, two pairs of wings and six legs
subjects.must: three body sections; wings; six legs

subjects.subject: Scientific close-up of a salt crystal lattice showing a cubic grid of two kinds of spheres alternating in every direction
subjects.must: cubic grid; two sphere kinds; they alternate

subjects.subject: Technical cutaway of a planetary gear set showing one central sun gear, exactly three planet gears around it and an outer ring gear
subjects.must: one sun gear; exactly three planets; outer ring

subjects.subject: A scatter of circles and triangles on a plane, split by one vertical and one horizontal straight line into three coloured rectangular regions
subjects.must: two marker shapes; straight axis-aligned split lines; three regions in different colours

subjects.subject: A large branching tree diagram of about fifteen nodes on the left, an arrow, and a smaller tree of about seven nodes on the right
subjects.must: two trees, each with one root; left clearly larger; arrow from left to right

subjects.subject: One smooth wave curve over one period with a staircase line of about eight flat steps that follows it closely
subjects.must: one smooth wave; one stepped line; the steps follow the wave

subjects.subject: A row of exactly five rounded tiles, an arrow down from each tile, and under each a tall narrow column of four small cells
subjects.must: exactly five tiles; one arrow per tile; five columns of cells

subjects.subject: Three horizontal segmented strips at the left; the top two feed a round multiply node, then a small bar chart with one tallest bar, which with the third strip feeds a round sum node
subjects.must: three strips; two round nodes; a bar group with one tallest; arrows in that order

subjects.subject: Three bars of clearly different heights on the left, an arrow, and three bars on the right in the same order of height, all rising from one baseline
subjects.must: two groups of three bars; same height order in both; an arrow between

subjects.subject: Nested oval contour rings, at least four, with a path of dots stepping from the outer ring to the centre, the steps getting shorter
subjects.must: at least four nested rings; a dotted path ending at the centre; steps shrink

subjects.subject: A scatter of blue circles and orange squares with one star among them and a ring drawn around the star enclosing exactly five neighbours
subjects.must: two marker kinds; one star; a ring around the star with five points inside

subjects.subject: A five by five grid of cells with a three by three block highlighted, an arrow, and a three by three grid with one cell highlighted
subjects.must: a 5x5 grid; a 3x3 highlighted window; a smaller output grid with one highlighted cell

subjects.subject: Two curves over the same axis: one falls steadily, the other falls then rises again, with a vertical dashed line at the turning point
subjects.must: two curves; one keeps falling; one turns up; dashed vertical line at the turn

subjects.subject: Three columns of circles, three then four then two, with a straight line from every circle to every circle in the next column
subjects.must: columns of 3, 4, 2; lines only between neighbouring columns

subjects.subject: A small three-column network of circles with blue arrows running left to right above it and orange arrows running right to left below it
subjects.must: a layered network; one arrow set each way; the two sets in different colours

subjects.subject: A vertical stack of four identical rounded blocks with one arrow rising through them and one curved arrow that skips around a single block
subjects.must: four stacked blocks; an upward arrow; one skip arrow around one block

subjects.subject: Two towers of three stacked blocks side by side, with an arrow from the top of the left tower into the side of the right tower
subjects.must: two towers; three blocks each; an arrow from left top to right

subjects.subject: A plane of dots in three separate clusters, with two arrows of the same length and direction joining two pairs of dots
subjects.must: three clusters; two arrows; the arrows are parallel and equal

subjects.subject: Four round targets in a two by two grid: dots tight at the centre, tight but off centre, spread around the centre, spread and off centre
subjects.must: four targets; the four dot patterns as described

subjects.subject: Three small panels with the same scattered dots: a straight line through them, a smooth curve through them, a wiggly line touching every dot
subjects.must: three panels; same dots; line, smooth curve, wiggly curve in that order

subjects.subject: A three-column network of circles in which two circles are greyed out with a cross and the lines to them are missing
subjects.must: a layered network; at least two crossed or grey nodes; their lines absent or faded

subjects.subject: Five stages left to right joined by arrows: a speech bubble, a stack of pages, three chosen pages, a rounded machine block, a second speech bubble
subjects.must: five stages in a row; arrows between; a pile of pages then a few chosen ones

subjects.subject: A row of nine boxes with three pointer arrows under it at the left end, the middle and the right end, and the left half of the row greyed out
subjects.must: nine boxes; three pointers at left, middle, right; one half greyed
